data.name: Septaluna
data.detailed_description:
Your brother Artiom was meant to be hauling pyroneum, not vanishing into thin space. Three years later, his freighter suddenly reappears on the networks, broadcasting a signal the military is far too eager to bury. Bad luck for them: you’re Nell — hacker, sister, and proud breaker of classified firewalls.

What begins as a personal search very soon collides with corporate greed and military secrecy - and leaves you running straight into a cover-up so carefully staged it could shake the balance of power across Heptara and its seven moons. Something MUCH bigger is happening here...

Septaluna is a narrative-driven Sci-Fi adventure that blends heartfelt arcs with sharp, witty dialogue.

Play as two perspectives

Artiom, the weary space hauler trapped in survival, and Nell, the hacker determined to uncover the truth.

Investigate and interact:

Talk to NPCs, give and take items, combine tools, and dig through networks like social media and intelligence feeds.

Experience decades of story

...through memo-capsules, replaying fragments of survival, alien encounters, and choices that ripple through time.

Branching choices

Your actions shape relationships, outcomes, and the fate of an entire world. Well, that last one may have been a bit over the top :-)

At its heart, Septaluna is about connection — a brother and sister torn apart by circumstance, a soldier forced to question his orders, and weirdos that you would usually find in a Point & Click Adventure.

Uncover the truth. Decide the fate of a planet. And maybe, just maybe, bring your brother home.

data.short_description: First your brother vanishes on a space freighter, then the military buries the case deeper than grandma’s secret pie recipe. Now - three years later - the ship’s sending signals. Time to hack, snoop, and stir trouble — and uncover a mystery of unexpected scale.
